title: Genus dominates graph genus for a minimal numerical type

standard_prerequisites.name: Elementary graph homology, weighted symmetric intersection matrices and the explicit definitions of numerical type, minimality and genus retained in the source.
standard_prerequisites.use: These are the named standard inputs; the selected main construction and its local nonroutine support remain in full.

core_obligations: Decompose the numerical type around its graph cycles and control the local contributions to its genus.
Use minimality and the cut-vertex analysis to rule out negative contributions in the residual subgraphs.

difficulty_reason:
题面（b8-dump.txt:2427-2434；源 models.tex statement_lines=[694, 698]，env=lemma，label=lemma-genus-nonnegative），逐字为 "\begin{lemma}\label{lemma-genus-nonnegative} If $n, m_i, a_{ij}, w_i, g_i$ is a minimal numerical type with $n > 1$, then $g \geq g_{top}$.\end{lemma}"（dump:2430-2434）。实质要求：对 $n>1$ 的极小数值型（曲线约化所附的组合数据：分支数 $n$、重数 $m_i$、相交数 $a_{ij}$，$i \not= j$ 时 $\geq 0$、$a_{ii} < 0$、$a_{ij} = a_{ji}$，权 $w_i$，亏格 $g_i$，满足逐行 $\sum_j a_{ij}m_j = 0$），证明 $g = 1 + \sum m_i(w_i(g_i - 1) - \frac{1}{2} a_{ii})$ 不低于拓扑亏格 $g_{top} = 1 - n + \frac{1}{2}\sum_{a_{ij} > 0} 1$。这是对所有极小数值型一致成立的下界，必须逐构形处理，单个特例不足以成事。

允许引用什么：(i) 数值型定义本身——证明在 dump:2516-2517 明说 "Looking at the definition of a numerical type we see that" 并列出 dump:2518-2523 的方程组（由此读出 $a_{ij}/w_i$ 为非负整数，dump:2471-2474）；(ii) 极小性——dump:2524 "because the numerical type is minimal"；(iii) 被引件 Lemma \ref{lemma-non-irreducible-minimal-type-genus-at-least-one}，全证明仅两次引用（dump:2507、dump:2560），其陈述不在 dump 收录范围内，本判定按使用位置认定其功能。

哪些部分必须由本证明完成（具体做法，均为本证明自造）：(a) 把 $g$ 与 $g_{top}$ 都改写成对 $i$ 的逐项和，从而把结论归约为逐项 $\Psi_i \geq 0$（dump:2440-2466，$\Psi_i$ 定义式在 dump:2462-2466）；(b) 作者自陈逐点命题不一定成立并自行定位负项："However, this may not be the case. Let us analyze for which indices we can have $\Psi_i < 0$."（dump:2467-2468），据此定出 $P = \{i : \Psi_i < 0\}$ 并算出 $i \in P \Rightarrow \Psi_i = \frac{1}{2}(-m_iw_i + 1)$（dump:2479-2487）；(c) 自造再分配策略（dump:2488-2489 "The strategy of proof is to show that given $i \in P$ we can borrow a bit from $\Psi_j$ where $j$ is the neighbour of $i$"），并自造中性集合 $Z$（dump:2493-2498）与沿 $Z$ 的极大序列 $M = (i, j_1, \ldots, j_s)$（dump:2499-2502）；(d) 对极大序列的汇点 $k$ 先证 $k \not\in Z$、$k \not\in P$（dump:2511-2514），再用数值型方程与极小性递推得 $m_k \geq 2m_i$（dump:2518-2527）；(e) 自造分解 $\Psi_k = -\sum_{b = 1, \ldots, t} \Psi_{i_b} + \Psi_k'$（dump:2538-2555），反证 $\Psi_k' < 0$（dump:2556），核心估计 $\frac{a_{kj_{b, s_b}}}{w_k} - \frac{m_{i_b}w_{i_b}}{m_kw_k} = \frac{w_{i_b}}{w_k}(1 - \frac{m_{i_b}}{m_k}) \geq \frac{1}{2}$（dump:2563-2569，用 $m_k \geq 2m_{i_b}$ 与 $a_{ij}/w_i$ 为非负整数），最后按 $t$、$w_k$、$a_{kl}$ 逐情形排除负号（dump:2570-2578）。被引件只出现在 $g_{top} = 0$ 的两处退化构形：dump:2503-2508（两指标在 $P$、其余指标在 $Z$，dump:2506 "$g_{top} = 0$ and we win by"）与 dump:2557-2560（$\{1, \ldots, n\} = M \cup \{k\}$，证明先自算 "$e = n - 1$ in this case" 再引），那里所证不等式退化为 $g \geq 0$，主线机制不来自被引件。

原文笔误（照抄并标注，不静默改正）：dump:2534 作 "We will show that $\Phi_j + \sum_{b = 1, \ldots, t} \Phi_{i_b} \geq 0$."——按上下文（dump:2539-2540 的分解以 $\Psi_k$ 为主项，汇点记作 $k$）此处 $\Phi$ 应为 $\Psi$、下标 $j$ 应为 $k$；dump:2458-2459 作 "the last equality uses that uses $a_{ij} = a_{ji}$"（"uses that uses" 重复）；dump:2574 作 "If there at least two nonzero terms in the sum over $l$"（缺 are）；dump:2575 作 "if there is one such $k$ and $a_{kl} > w_k$"（按上下文应为 "one such $l$"）。以上四处均照抄并标注，未静默改正。

compared.difference: Single migration of this unpublished research record.

This is a combinatorial inequality for arbitrary minimal numerical types; the companion geometric model-rigidity result uses only the easier genus-zero type classification, not this graph-genus inequality.
